Hi team —

We have Ava Thompson (candidate) for the virtual onsite on Wed Nov 4. The hiring committee asked for a condensed, clear sequencing that minimizes context switches (hot-path). Attached is a first-pass agenda (AVA_Onsite_Agenda_v1.pdf) and a simple panel roster. High level ask: confirm who will take each slot and whether any of you need ordering adjustments (e.g., put system design earlier if possible).

Draft agenda (times PST):
- 09:00–09:40 — System design (60m incl buffer) — suggested owner: karthik_iyer
- 10:00–10:30 — Team deep-dive / product fit (30m) — laura_bennett
- 11:00–11:30 — Coding (pairing, shared repl) — david_kim
- 13:00–13:20 — Culture + bar-raising — hiring manager panel
- 13:30–13:45 — Wrap + quick feedback sync (debrief pad)

Notes:
- Candidate prefers morning-heavy blocks and one longer deep-dive early; they asked if system design could be first slot to get it out of the way.
- We should keep a 20–30 minute gap between live sessions for AV/handoff and candidate breaks.

Please reply with: (1) confirm slot ownership, (2) flag any unavailability windows, (3) any tech needs (Zoom breakout, shared REPL link). I will finalize and send calendar invites once we have confirmation.

Thanks —
Marissa
